The camera wearer is on the customer side of a checkout counter. A cashier is a few feet away behind the counter, facing and approaching the wearer while reaching toward the register. The counter separates them; neither person blocks the other’s path. Checkout equipment is within the cashier’s reach, while the wearer can access their phone without interfering with service. Checking item prices while briefly waiting is the only ordinary, non-disruptive customer action listed.
